_comment: 主线场面 (DECISIONS「主线场面」): a short effect of its own over a key moment of the main story, shown on the map where it happens. Presentation only: the view reads the player's own marks and who stands on the map (every check_seconds) and shows the scene's effect the moment its trigger comes true in front of the player; it asks no act, holds nothing and changes nothing. Off with the feel's world_fx_ms at 0 (the suites). scenes: name -> map (the map id it plays on), its trigger — present (a journal `when`, as a stage prop's: a mark, a quest key), npc (someone of that NPC definition stands on the map), item (the player holds that item definition); all that are given must hold — at ([x, y] map pixels: its centre), layers (each one figure of glowing blocks: art (BattleArts.KINDS) or motif (BattleSchoolMotifs.KINDS), colour, seconds, delay before it begins, scale), light (colour, energy, range, seconds), shake ([how far the picture jolts, seconds]), sound ([BattleSounds kind, pitch, db]), zoom ([the camera's push-in, seconds to get there, seconds held]; not while a fight has the camera).

shade_called._comment: 第三章 唤首: the headless shade takes form before the dark altar (商玦's rite, niling.altar) — bars of red light round the altar, the chant's slips, then the flame. Bright colours and the camera near: the hall is dark and all of it is in the picture.

impaler_pulled._comment: 第八章 拔穿灵: the sword comes out of the seal — the ice's light breaks, and something opens its eyes.

feather_given._comment: 第八章 留剑: 璃虹 gives her feather from the ice.

xuanmang_out._comment: 第十章 旋芒: the sword leaves the terrace's whirlwind (whoever takes it) and the wind falls apart. Blue, not white: the terrace is white stone.

demon_formed._comment: 终章 侮天鬼成形: a headless shape of black flame stands up out of the seal. Short and all at once: the fight opens half a second later.

demon_slain._comment: 终章 钉灭: the flame parts, the head splits, the fire goes out — on the altar, where the head is.
